name: Superhero
definition: A named comic-book superhero character; each record represents one hero and carries the hero's name, full name, demographic lookups and physical measurements.
scope: All hero-level counting, filtering and comparison in the superhero database.

name: Hero Name
definition: The public superhero codename used to identify a hero, for example 3-D Man or Hawkman.
scope: Identifying and filtering heroes by the name used in analytical questions.

name: Full Name
definition: The hero's full personal name, distinct from the superhero codename; the value is absent when the full name is not recorded.
scope: Questions asking for a hero's full or real name, or for heroes lacking a full name.

name: Publisher
definition: The publishing company that created or published the superhero.
scope: Publisher filtering, comparison, grouping and percentage calculations.

name: Race
definition: The hero's species or race category, for example Human, Mutant or Kryptonian.
scope: Species and race filtering of heroes.

name: Colour
definition: A controlled vocabulary of colour labels shared by the eye, hair and skin appearance attributes; it includes a No Colour value denoting an unrecorded colour.
scope: Interpreting and joining colour identifiers used by hero appearance attributes.

name: Eye Colour
definition: The recorded eye colour of a hero, expressed as a colour-vocabulary value.
scope: Appearance questions referring to eyes, including blue eyes and no eye color.

name: Hair Colour
definition: The recorded hair colour of a hero, expressed as a colour-vocabulary value.
scope: Appearance questions referring to hair, including blond hair and black hair.

name: Skin Colour
definition: The recorded skin colour of a hero, expressed as a colour-vocabulary value.
scope: Appearance questions referring to skin colour.

name: Hero Attribute
definition: One of six rated hero attributes: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power and Combat.
scope: Attribute-based comparison and ranking of heroes.

name: Attribute Score
definition: A numeric rating of how strongly a hero possesses a given attribute, on a 0 to 100 scale where a higher score is stronger.
scope: Ranking and comparing heroes on a single attribute.

name: Superpower
definition: A named superpower that a hero may possess, drawn from a controlled list such as Agility, Stealth or Telepathy.
scope: Questions about which powers a hero has, or how many heroes possess a power.

name: Height
definition: The hero's height in centimetres; zero or NULL indicates the height is not recorded.

name: Weight
definition: The hero's weight in kilograms; zero or NULL indicates the weight is not recorded.
